description: This file declares functions related to inserting quantization and dequantization nodes in a PyTorch JIT graph, specifically for handling quantization patterns within the compiler infrastructure.

methods.name: ReplicateQuant
methods.description: Replicates quantize nodes for prim::If blocks to match quantization patterns.

methods.name: ReplicateDeQuant
methods.description: Replicates dequantize nodes for each use to match quantization patterns.

methods.name: InsertQuantDeQuant
methods.description: Inserts quantize-dequantize calls into tensors observed during the insert_observers pass, based on observer modules.

methods.name: InsertQuantDeQuantOnDevicePTQ
methods.description: Inserts quantize-dequantize calls on the device for post-training quantization (PTQ).
